summary.text: Tim O'Driscoll is a Republican who represents District 13B in the Minnesota House of Representatives and was first elected in 2010.

His official House page lists him as chair of the Legislative Commission on Pensions and Retirement and a member of Commerce Finance and Policy, and gives his occupation as corporate trainer, with a B.S. in real estate and business education from St. Cloud State University.

sources.title: Rep. Tim O'Driscoll (13B) - Minnesota House of Representatives
